name: reiser-plugins
description: Private plugin marketplace — Office document tooling, house-style templates, and Taiwan legal research.

plugins.name: office-cli
plugins.description: Office document toolkit — routes decks to a style template, deck-design/deck-build or the OfficeCLI document DOM, with three interchangeable house-style templates (ANA Blue, Yukima 雪間, Reiser Warm) applied by default.

plugins.name: tw-legal-rag
plugins.description: Taiwan legal research — semantic retrieval over ~22M court judgments plus administrative interpretations via the TLR endpoint, with enforced citation discipline and bundle-level citation checking. Retrieval only; generates no legal advice.
